Description: TypeError in validate_discount() when passing max threshold
Root_Cause: Function signature only declared 1 positional parameter while caller supplied 2
Resolution: Updated validate_discount signature to accept optional max_percent parameter

Description: ZeroDivisionError when computing Average Order Value on empty day
Reproducible_Steps: Invoke get_dashboard_metrics() on database with 0 completed orders
Root_Cause: Divided total_sales by completed_count without checking for zero
Resolution: Added conditional guard returning Decimal('0.00') when completed_count == 0

Description: Historical invoice totals corrupted when menu prices modified in catalog
Reproducible_Steps: Create bill with Dish A at ₹200; update catalog price to ₹300; view past invoice
Root_Cause: Query joined menu_items table dynamically instead of reading static invoice snapshot
Resolution: Added item_name and unit_price snapshot columns to order_items

Description: Negative prices or quantities accepted without boundary validation
Reproducible_Steps: Enter -50 for price or -2 for quantity
Root_Cause: Missing non-negative and non-zero boundary checks in initial parser
Resolution: Added validate_price() and validate_quantity() with strict positive integer checks

Description: Raw SQLite IntegrityError unhandled when adding duplicate dish in same category
Root_Cause: SQLite UNIQUE constraint triggered without friendly validation message
Resolution: Added duplicate pre-check in MenuService.add_item returning friendly error message

Description: Theme preference reverted to default dark mode upon restarting application
Reproducible_Steps: Switch to light mode; close app; relaunch app; theme is dark
Root_Cause: Theme state was stored only in runtime memory without SQLite persistence
Resolution: Implemented user_settings table and SettingsRepository with automatic restore

Description: Orphaned child records permitted because SQLite foreign keys default to disabled
Reproducible_Steps: Insert child row with non-existent parent_id
Root_Cause: SQLite disables foreign key enforcement by default on new connections

Description: Floating point rounding error in tax and discount calculation
Reproducible_Steps: Calculate 5% tax on ₹999.99 with float arithmetic
Root_Cause: Python standard float produces IEEE 754 precision inaccuracies
Resolution: Migrated all financial arithmetic to Python Decimal with quantize('0.01')

Description: Keyboard shortcuts not working when Caps Lock or Shift engaged
Reproducible_Steps: Press Alt+n with Caps Lock enabled
Root_Cause: Tkinter key symbol matching is case-sensitive by default
Resolution: Bound both uppercase and lowercase accelerators (<Alt-n> and <Alt-N>)

Description: UnicodeEncodeError on Windows cp1252 console when displaying Unicode emoji characters
Reproducible_Steps: Execute python scripts/manage_db.py status on Windows Command Prompt
Root_Cause: Windows console code page defaults to cp1252 which cannot encode UTF-8 emojis
Resolution: Reconfigured stdout/stderr encoding and migrated console outputs to safe ASCII tags

Description: Matplotlib Figure memory accumulation on frequent chart period and theme refreshes
Reproducible_Steps: Switch between 7/14/30 days repeatedly in ReportsFrame
Root_Cause: FigureCanvasTkAgg widgets destroyed without invoking plt.close(fig) on parent figures
Resolution: Added _clear_old_figures() tracking active figures and explicitly closing with plt.close()

Description: sqlite3.OperationalError: database is locked during batch demo transaction seeding
Root_Cause: Open read cursor on primary connection held lock while order_service tried to open write transaction
Resolution: Isolated read query lifecycle and decoupled connection before order creation loop
